title: Classic Bacon Carbonara
summary: A rich, silky Italian-style carbonara with crisp bacon, egg, parmesan and plenty of black pepper. It is quick enough for a weeknight dinner but feels comforting and indulgent.
steps: Bring a large pan of water to the boil, add the salt, then cook the pasta until al dente according to the packet instructions. Before draining, reserve about 150 ml of the starchy pasta water.
While the pasta cooks, whisk the eggs with the grated parmesan and black pepper in a bowl until well combined and thick. Set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the bacon and crushed garlic, then cook for 5–7 minutes until the bacon is crisp and golden at the edges. Remove and discard the garlic.
Add the drained pasta to the bacon pan and toss for 30 seconds so it is coated in the bacon fat. Take the pan off the heat and let it cool for about 30 seconds so the eggs will not scramble.
Pour in the egg and parmesan mixture, tossing constantly with tongs. Add reserved pasta water a little at a time until the sauce turns glossy and creamy and coats the pasta.
Taste and add more black pepper if liked. Serve immediately with any extra parmesan if desired.
